title: Oven Steamed Saudi Sevaiiya Curry
description: A creamy, savory curry featuring fine sevaiiya noodles, infused with aromatic spices and finished in a bamboo steamer for a cozy oven‑steamed experience.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and place a shallow pan of water at the bottom of the oven.
Heat cooking oil in a skillet and add cumin seeds until fragrant.
Add diced onion, minced garlic, and diced tomato, sautéing until the onion softens.
Stir in ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, and garam masala, cooking for 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly.
Rinse sevaiiya until clear, then add it to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Let the mixture simmer for 3 minutes until the sevaiiya is al dente.
Transfer the curry into a clean bamboo steamer lined with parchment, cover tightly with foil.
Place the steamer on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes to steam.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh cilantro if desired and spoon extra coconut milk into each bowl.
Serve hot straight from the steamer for a comforting, creamy Saudi sevaiiya curry.
